evals.prompt: Our marketing home page has LCP 4.1 s and CLS 0.24 at p75 on mobile (CrUX). The hero is a 2.4 MB PNG loaded with loading=lazy, web fonts swap late and a cookie banner pushes content down. Audit and fix.
evals.expected_output: An audit using the CrUX baseline, identifying the hero image as the LCP element, removing lazy loading on it, adding fetchpriority and a modern format with srcset, reserving space for the cookie banner or overlaying it, matching font fallback metrics, and planning before/after measurement and budgets.
assertions: Lazy loading is removed from the LCP image
The cookie banner layout shift is addressed
Before and after measurement is planned
